title: Activate the Fallback
tagline: Keep going when the model goes down
objective: Ship the outage notice even when the model writing it is the thing that is down.
description: There is a Retry block in front of the model, and it is doing its job: two tries, both refused, run over. Retrying a provider that is down just fails twice as slowly. What this workflow needs is somewhere else to go. Add a Fallback block set to 'alternate provider' pointing at 'mock-backup'. When the main model is exhausted, the backup writes the notice instead - and says so, right in the output.

sample_input.impact: Roughly 8% of checkout requests are returning 503 errors.

expected_output: An outage notice with a headline, a body of at least a couple of sentences, and the name of the model that wrote it.

config.prompt: Write a public outage notice from this incident brief. Return JSON with headline, body and written_by.
config.system: You write calm, factual status-page notices. Always fill in written_by with which model you are.

solution_hint: Splice a Fallback block between 'Try twice' and 'Write the outage notice'. Set its mode to 'alternate provider' and its provider to 'mock-backup'. Guards stack in a chain, so Retry runs out of attempts first and the Fallback catches what is left.

failure_scenarios.label: The main model is down
failure_scenarios.description: The primary provider refuses the first two calls. Anything after that gets through.

detail.message: The main model provider is not responding.

completion_criteria: A Fallback block stands behind the model
The fallback actually fires and rescues the step
The published notice says which model wrote it
The run finishes at the Output block

data.headline: Checkout API returning errors for some customers
data.body: Since 09:12 UTC a portion of checkout requests are failing with 503 errors, affecting roughly 8% of attempts. Our engineers are working on it now and we will update this notice every 30 minutes until it is resolved.

data.headline: Checkout API degraded - written by the backup model
data.body: Some checkout requests have been failing since 09:12 UTC. About 8% of attempts return an error. This notice was produced by the backup model because the main provider was unavailable, and it will be refreshed every 30 minutes.
